title: Midday Sunwatch
text:
🌤️ Midday Sunwatch — November 23, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B1.6)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B2.8 (Peaked November 23, 2026 at 09:56 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 327 km/s (Calm)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 0.67)

A small sunspot, several bright active regions, and a broad coronal-hole-like area are visible today, while the outer corona looks quiet.

Images: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 195, 284, 171, 304, 131, 094 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
